No. The repo rules make `is.waiwai.dictation` permanent. macOS keys Accessibility grants to the bundle ID, so renaming it would silently revoke permission for every existing user, and Sparkle would treat the app as a different one.

You can rename what users see before launch without touching the identifier: set `CFBundleName` and `CFBundleDisplayName` to OpenRamble. The grant stays.

If you still want `is.waiwai.openramble`, that means changing the invariant in the rules file first, and only if no build with a real Accessibility grant has shipped. I can't edit files in this session, so the display-name change would need to run in a session with repo access.
